verifiedAgainst: Automattic/vip-design-system 2.23.9-dev.0: src/system/index.ts (the package's export list), each component's own .tsx, and each story's `tags` (`deprecated`, `new`), 2026-09-24. Usage cross-checked against vip-dashboard on 2.23.8.
note: Component currency, not props. `status`: `recommended` (use it), `legacy` (a story tagged `deprecated`, or a JSDoc `@deprecated` — `supersededBy` names the replacement). Every export is a named import off `@automattic/vip-design-system`; six of them are namespaces rather than components — `NewDialog`, `Form`, `Dropdown`, `Drawer`, `Accordion` and `Nav` — so the registry names the namespace and the note names its parts (`NewDialog.Root`, `Form.Select`, `Dropdown.Item`, …). Almost every component is a thin wrapper over its Theme UI namesake and takes Theme UI's `sx` and `variant`; read the component's own `.tsx` in the package's `src/system/` for the rest. Re-verify against `src/system/index.ts` and the stories' `tags` before bumping this file's version.

components.name: Box
components.note: The generic block, and the one to reach for instead of a styled `<div>`. Theme UI's `Box`: polymorphic via `as`, styled through `sx` with theme keys. It is not a layout primitive on its own — it has no `gap`; siblings in a row or column want `Flex`, cells in columns want `Grid`.

components.name: Flex
components.note: Theme UI's `Flex`: a `Box` with `display: flex`. Siblings along one axis. Spacing between them is `sx={{ gap: <space step> }}` on the `Flex`, never a margin on each child. `flexDirection: 'column'` for a vertical stack.

components.name: Grid
components.note: Theme UI's `Grid`: `columns` (a count, a track list, or a responsive array), `gap` (a space step), `width` (a minimum column width that makes it auto-fill). Cells that must line up in columns across rows are this, not a wrapping `Flex`.

components.name: Heading
components.note: Every heading. `variant` is `h1`…`h6` (default `h3`) and sets the element and the type style together. Never pick a variant for its size, and never style a `<h2>` by hand.

components.name: Text
components.note:
Running text, a `

` by default (`as` for another element). It carries `marginBottom: 2` of its own: inside a `Flex` or `Grid` with a `gap`, set `sx={{ mb: 0 }}` rather than letting the two spacings stack. Size and colour come from theme keys in `sx` (`fontSize: 1`, `color: 'texts.secondary'`), not literals.

components.name: Link
components.note: An in-app or inline anchor. `variant`: `primary` (default) or a button look (`button-primary`, `button-secondary`, `button-tertiary`, `button-ghost`, `button-display`, `button-danger`) for navigation that must look like an action — an action that navigates nowhere is a `Button`.

components.name: LinkExternal
components.note: A link that leaves the dashboard: adds the new-tab icon and the screen-reader "opens in a new tab" text. Use it rather than `Link` with `target="_blank"`.

components.name: Code
components.note: Inline code, or a block; `showCopy` adds a copy-to-clipboard button.

components.name: Hr
components.note: A themed horizontal divider. Not a `Box` with a border-bottom.

components.name: ScreenReaderText
components.note: Text for assistive technology only. Not a hand-written visually-hidden class.

components.name: DescriptionList
components.note: Label/value pairs from a `list` prop, as a `dl` or (`as="table"`) a table. Reach for this before a `Grid` of `Text` pairs.

components.name: ResultsSummary
components.note: The live "N results" line above a filtered list. It owns the `aria-live` wiring; do not rebuild it from `Text` + `role="status"`.

components.name: Card
components.note: A surface grouping related content. `variant`: `primary` (default) | `secondary` | `notice` | `indent`. `title` or `renderHeader` for a header; `headerStyles` and `bodyStyles` reach the two regions, so a consumer never targets them by class.

components.name: Table
components.note: Tabular data. Parts are separate named exports: `TableRow`, `TableCell` (`head` for a header cell). Never rebuild a table from `Grid` or `Flex` rows.

components.name: OptionRow
components.note: A navigable row: leading `image`, `label` (a link), `subTitle`, `body`, `badge`, trailing `meta` (a forward arrow by default). Lists of things the user drills into.

components.name: ServiceHeader
components.note: The header of a service page: `title`, `description`, `status` (a lifecycle badge), `actions`, `message`. Use it on a service screen rather than assembling a `Card` of `Heading` + `Badge` + `Button`s.

components.name: Notice
components.note: A message that stays on the page. `variant`: `warning` (default) | `error` | `alert` | `success` | `info`; `title`; `inline` for a transparent background; `dismissible`/`onDismiss`; `collapsible`. A message that leaves on its own is a `Snackbar`.

components.name: Snackbar
components.note: A transient message — the result of an action. `variant`, `title`, `loading`, a call to action via `ctaText`/`ctaHref`/`ctaOnClick`.

components.name: Badge
components.note: A short status or category label. `variant` is a colour: `blue` (default) | `gold` | `gray` | `green` | `orange` | `red` | `salmon` | `yellow`. Not a control.

components.name: Spinner
components.note: An indeterminate wait. A placeholder whose layout is known is `Skeleton`; a wait with a number is `Progress`. A button that is busy takes `loading` rather than a `Spinner` beside it.

components.name: Button
components.note: `variant`: `primary` | `secondary` | `tertiary` | `ghost` | `display` | `text` | `icon`. Destructive is the `danger` prop on any variant — the `danger` variant is on its way out. `loading` for a busy state, `full` to fill the width, `preferAriaDisabled` to stay focusable while disabled.

components.name: ButtonSubmit
components.note: A form's submit button, with its pending state. Not a `Button` with `type="submit"` and a hand-managed spinner.

components.name: ButtonVariant
components.note: The enum of `Button` variants, for typing — not a component.

components.name: ToggleGroup
components.note: A segmented control: one value chosen from a small set of options. Choosing a view or a mode is this, not a row of `Button`s holding pressed state by hand.

components.name: Form
components.note: The form namespace: `Form.Root`, `Form.Input`, `Form.Textarea`, `Form.Label`, `Form.Select`, `Form.Autocomplete`, `Form.AutocompleteMulti`, `Form.InputWithCopyButton`, `Form.Fieldset`, `Form.Legend`. A value chosen from a list is `Form.Select` (searchable) or `Form.Autocomplete`, never a raw `<select>`.

components.name: Input
components.note: A text input. The same component as `Form.Input`.

components.name: Textarea
components.note: The same component as `Form.Textarea`.

components.name: Label
components.note: A field's label, with its required marker. The same component as `Form.Label`.

components.name: Validation
components.note: A field's validation message, under the control. Not a red `Text`.

components.name: RadioBoxGroup
components.note: Radio options rendered as selectable cards, for a choice where each option needs a description.

components.name: RadioGroupChip
components.note: Radio options rendered as compact chips.

components.name: Toggle
components.note: An on/off switch that applies immediately. A value that only applies on submit is a `Checkbox`.

components.name: ToggleRow
components.note: A `Toggle` laid out as a settings row: `title`, `subTitle`, `body`, `badge`, `image`, `meta`. Reach for this before a `Flex` of `Heading` + `Text` + `Toggle`.

components.name: NewDialog
components.note: The modal dialog, on Radix. A namespace: `NewDialog.Root` (`trigger`, `title`, `description`, `content`, `open`/`onOpenChange`), plus `Title`, `Description`, `Close`, `CloseDefault` and `Overlay` for a custom body. A destructive confirmation is `NewConfirmationDialog`; a panel from an edge is `Drawer`.

components.name: NewConfirmationDialog
components.note: A confirmation: `trigger`, `title`, `description`, `label` (the confirm button's text), `buttonVariant`, `onConfirm`, `needsConfirm`. Never rebuild this out of `NewDialog` + two `Button`s. `body` is deprecated — use `description`.

components.name: Drawer
components.note: An edge-anchored panel. A namespace: `Drawer.Root` (`trigger`) and `Drawer.Content`, or `Drawer.Drawer` for both at once; `variant` picks the edge (`top` | `right` | `bottom` | `left` | `left-header` | `right-header`).

components.name: Dropdown
components.note: A menu of commands, on Radix. A namespace: `Dropdown.Root` takes the trigger as its `trigger` prop and the items as children — `Item`, `CheckboxItem`, `RadioGroup`, `RadioItem`, `ItemIndicator`, `Label`, `Separator`, `Sub`, `SubTrigger`, `SubContent`; `Trigger` and `Content` are there for a custom root. Choosing a form value is `Form.Select`, not this.

components.name: FilterDropdown
components.note: A dropdown picking one filter from `filters`, with the current choice shown in its trigger. Reach for this before building a filter menu from `Dropdown` parts.

components.name: NewTooltip
components.note: A short text label on hover/focus, on Radix. `content`, `position`, `arrow`. It holds nothing interactive.

components.name: Accordion
components.note: A namespace, on Radix: `Accordion.Root`, `Item`, `Trigger` (or `TriggerWithIcon`), `Content`.

components.name: Tabs
components.note: Peer views of one subject. Parts are separate named exports: `TabsList`, `TabsTrigger`, `TabsContent`. Tabs that navigate between routes are `Nav.Tab`, not this.

components.name: Nav
components.note: Navigation, on Radix NavigationMenu. A namespace of variants — `Nav.Primary`, `Nav.PrimaryInverse`, `Nav.Tab`, `Nav.Toolbar`, `Nav.Menu` — each with a required `label`, and `NavItem` (a separate named export) for its entries.

components.name: Toolbar
components.note: The dashboard's top bar (a `header`): logo, navigation and account actions. Not a general action bar.

components.name: MobileMenu
components.note: With `MobileMenuTrigger` and `MobileMenuWrapper`: the small-screen navigation. Do not build a second one.

components.name: Pagination
components.note: Page-numbered navigation; `compact` for the short form. Cursor-based navigation is `SimplePagination`.

components.name: Wizard
components.note: A multi-step flow with `steps`, `activeStep`, `completed`, `skipped`, `errored`; `WizardStep` is one step.

components.name: theme
components.note: The Theme UI theme object, for `ThemeUIProvider`. Not a component — and reading a colour out of it to write a literal defeats the dark mode it exists to switch.

components.name: Dialog
components.supersededBy: NewDialog (a modal) or Dropdown (a menu anchored to a trigger)
components.note: The old anchored, click-outside dialog. Its story is tagged `deprecated`.

components.name: ConfirmationDialog
components.note: Its story is tagged `deprecated`.

components.name: Tooltip
components.note: `@deprecated Use NewTooltip instead` in its own source.
